blocks.content: After auto-apply is on, you still own exemptions, whether the segment is ready, and the mode. Some settings combine series and others discard a metric. Each one is a rule.

| Rule or recommendation | What stays in your control |
| --- | --- |
| Custom rules | A rule you created yourself. You can still add and edit custom rules. |
| Affix or drop rules | An affix rule matches a prefix or suffix in the metric name. A drop rule discards the metric. Auto-apply leaves these rules as they are. |
| Exact-match rules | A rule for one metric name, including one you created. Auto-apply can remove or replace it unless you exempted that metric. |
| Recommendations that add too many series | In **Cost-first**, a recommendation that would push the increase past what the reductions applied at the same time free up isn't applied automatically. It stays pending, and you can still apply it from the UI. |
